title: Sal Pais applauds Rossi's panel example

tellings.quote: panel one time with Sal Pais and a handful of others last two summers ago and basically I used this exact example and Sal Pais started basically clapping

plain: Dave Rossi tells podcast host Jesse Michels that about two summers before, around 2023, he spoke on a panel with Salvatore Pais and several others. He says that when he used a particular physics example, Pais started clapping, which Rossi takes as a sign that his ideas have support.
